Japanese Review (Seafood and Nam Danh)
Jun 2025 • Couples
Nam Danh, a seafood restaurant, was told by Thao, a staff member at the hotel where I was staying.
To be honest, it's in a pretty deep place, in the back of a narrow alley (laughs).
But Thao had told me beforehand that it was a little hard to find, so I was fine.

When we actually went there, we found it was a really good place to recommend!
The seafood is very fresh and delicious, and the prices are much more reasonable than at other restaurants.
Moreover, it is packed with locals and tourists! I'm also convinced by this popularity.

It was a bit hard to find, but it was well worth it.
It was a wonderful experience that left a lasting impression on me during my trip.

Disappointed
Nov 2023 • Couples
Fresh seafood, quite delicious, clean bathroom. But the staff's attitude was too poor, sitting in a bunch of chatty customers, no one brought out the menu to ask. When the staff complained that their throat was burning, they brought a menu book to a couple of bags in the middle of the table and even brought the 3-page menu book to ask. Why is the food so small? I'll turn around and give you another notebook. My friend and I were about to leave and not eat anymore because of that attitude, but because it was raining that day and the road was far away, it was hard to find, so we sat down and finished eating. The restaurant is great, the food is delicious, but the staff's attitude is like looking down on customers. I hope the restaurant will improve. It's very difficult to find a restaurant in the alley but I'm really disappointed....
